definitions.explanation: Describes two things so deeply connected that they cannot be considered separately.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}り{離|はな}せない⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧だ。
examples.english: These two have an inseparable relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}り{離|はな}せない。
examples.english: The economy and the environment are inseparable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}り{離|はな}せない⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese culture and the four seasons are inextricably linked.

notes:
The negative potential form of ⟦{切|き}り{離|はな}す→切り離す：05763_kirihanasu⟧ (to separate; to detach), used as a set expression meaning "cannot be separated" or "inseparable." Commonly used to describe deep connections between concepts, people, or things.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}り{離|はな}せない: A and B are inseparable
- {切|き}り{離|はな}せない⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: an inseparable relationship
- ～⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{切|き}り{離|はな}せない: inseparable from ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不可分|ふかぶん}→不可分：24459_fukabun⟧: indivisible — more formal and academic
- ⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: a close relationship — similar but less emphatic
- ⟦{表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}→表裏一体：14082_hyouriittai⟧: two sides of the same coin
